person.name: Nicholas Kloster
person.headline: Independent security researcher and tool builder
person.summary: I investigate AI infrastructure, applications, and firmware. I build tools to test security assumptions, trace software behavior, and document findings that other researchers can reproduce.
person.background: Previously served eight years in the U.S. Army as an Infantry Staff Sergeant, including two deployments to Kandahar.

provenance.note: Descriptions and links were transcribed from the owner's portfolio. External evidence has not been independently verified. This is a selected public project catalog, not a complete repository inventory.

projects.name: Ablation
projects.summary: Analyze compiled software with a framework for binary lifting, data-flow analysis, semantic search, and persistent research findings.
projects.problem: Investigate firmware and stripped binaries when source code and symbols are unavailable.

projects.name: Ablation Case Studies
projects.summary: Publish investigations that connect analysis output to the evidence used to assess findings.
projects.problem: Make reverse engineering results reviewable and reproducible.

projects.name: RXVM
projects.summary: Reconstruct the bytecode interpreter and neural-network structure of a client-side bot detection system.
projects.problem: Understand browser-side detection logic from observable client behavior.

projects.name: aimap
projects.summary: Identify AI services and enumerate exposed inference servers, vector databases, and supporting infrastructure.
projects.problem: Determine which AI services are exposed and what their endpoints permit.

projects.name: gatecheck
projects.summary: Test whether inference gateways enforce authentication under altered headers, tokens, and request paths.
projects.problem: Check whether gateway authentication survives requests that challenge its trust assumptions.

projects.name: herald
projects.summary: Run declarative HTTP probes to check authentication across individual routes.
projects.problem: Find endpoints that fail to enforce the application's authentication policy.

projects.name: throttlecheck
projects.summary: Check login rate limits and lockout behavior using a fixed invalid credential.
projects.problem: Verify that configured login controls are enforced by the endpoint.

projects.name: VisorAgent
projects.summary: Test prompt-injection detection through tool-use paths.
projects.problem: Evaluate how an AI system handles adversarial content returned by its tools.

projects.name: injection-gate
projects.summary: Apply deterministic policy checks between an agent's proposed action and its execution.
projects.problem: Bound the actions a tool-using agent can take when it encounters untrusted input.

projects.name: nuclide-atlas
projects.summary: Map the relationships between models, retrieval systems, tools, and agents in an AI deployment.
projects.problem: Understand how connected components contribute to an AI system's exposure.

projects.name: qdrantscan
projects.summary: Assess Qdrant authentication and exposure of snapshot export endpoints.
projects.problem: Check whether a vector database exposes data or export operations without authentication.

projects.name: VisorLog
projects.summary: Track findings from discovery through review and closure in a shared SQLite ledger.
projects.problem: Preserve finding history across multiple assessment tools.

projects.name: winnow
projects.summary: Apply explicit rules to retain, refute, or downgrade scanner candidates.
projects.problem: Separate leads worth investigating from known false positives.

projects.name: NuClide Method
projects.summary: Document a process for assessing AI infrastructure and verifying scanner candidates.
projects.problem: Produce evidence-backed findings through a repeatable assessment process.

projects.name: white-bronco
projects.summary: Provide disclosure templates and writing guidance for independent security researchers.
projects.problem: Give vendor security teams clear reports they can reproduce and act on.

projects.name: AI/LLM Infrastructure OSINT
projects.summary: Publish case studies and methods from surveys of exposed AI infrastructure.
projects.problem: Connect observed deployment failures to repeatable security tests.

projects.name: spectral
projects.summary: Locate signatures of AI tools and frameworks in files, code, and logs.
projects.problem: Identify concrete artifacts left by AI software during a forensic review.

projects.name: safeconvert
projects.summary: Provide domestic violence resources through an offline-capable application presented as a unit converter.
projects.problem: Make safety resources accessible with privacy-conscious interface design.
